coverage_exceptions.note: Whole-object coverage not certified after fallback; measured geometry inclusion and actual clearance still passed.

limitations: Circular geometry prior and CV only; not universal shape identification or accelerated/human obstacle validation.
Absolute-centre errors change target semantics. Primary motion metrics are velocity and displacement.
Original MVEE promises visible-point enclosure, not the entire physical cylinder. Its lower full-object coverage does not mean all old trajectories collided.
Seed451 includes a fallback frame without full-object coverage certification. No all-time/full-object safety theorem.
2 s coverage uses held hard-window axes and is not 2 s hard CBF certification. 0.95 rule is not a 95% probability quantile.
No new multi-robot, wheel-odometry drift, real scan motion-distortion or physical tests. No hard realtime guarantee.
Raw scans/clusters/images/papers are not uploaded. Same-disk copies are not offsite backup.
